College Football Roundup: Numerous Teams Secure Victories

Multiple college football teams secured wins in recent matchups. San Jose State defeated Cal Poly 30-20, with the Weaver to Clark connection contributing two touchdowns. UCLA overcame a slow start to beat San Diego State. Hawaii defeated New Mexico State 29-19, powered by two rushing touchdowns from Rice. Akron beat Robert Morris 45-10, with Cibastian Broughton throwing four touchdown passes. South Dakota State downed New Haven 57-14, as Chase Mason scored four touchdowns. Alabama, ranked 12th, overcame a halftime deficit to beat Kentucky 45-17. Marshall rallied to defeat Middle Tennessee 28-26, with Turner-Bradshaw scoring two touchdowns. Northern Arizona ran past Incarnate Word 38-28. BYU, ranked 15th, beat Arizona 28-17 with Bear Bachmeier throwing three touchdowns. Arkansas State secured a 52-7 victory over West Georgia, led by Owens and the defense. Fresno State defeated Sacramento State 49-3.
